title: Chain rule for the tangential gradient: ∇^M(ψ∘h) = ψ'(h)∇^M h
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ, h : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ, ψ : ℝ → ℝ and x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ}. If h is differentiable at x and ψ is differentiable at h(x), then ∇^M(ψ∘h)(x) = ψ'(h(x)) ∇^M h(x), where ∇^M f(x) = V.tangentialGradient f x = p_{T_xV}(∇f(x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (x : Ambient n ℓ), DifferentiableAt ℝ h x → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ (h x) → V.tangentialGradient (fun y ↦ ψ (h y)) x = deriv ψ (h x) • V.tangentialGradient h x
